title: Campaign: connectomes, synapses and single neurons
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what do connectomes reveal about how nervous systems are built?'. Scope: Properties of individual synapses, contacts and neurons: synapse size and placement, glia at contacts, neuron morphology and cable scaling. 15 papers. Status: several rules found. In human H01, synapses of one connection share size (correlation 0.27 against 0.07 for neighbouring synapses of other axons), and a connection-specific size term remains; glia (oligodendrocytes, OPCs, microglia) sit at neuron somata in mouse and human; neuron cable grows more slowly with synapse number than optimal wiring predicts, and distal spine synapses are not size-compensated.
